The plate looks like a dinner plate of about 26 cm, and in the image it is about 360 px wide. That gives roughly 0.072 cm per px.

The pasta pile covers about 240 px by 200 px, which is roughly 17 cm by 14 cm. It is a modest pile, perhaps 3 cm thick at most, so I estimate about 250 g of cooked spaghetti with tomato sauce and vegetables (zucchini, spinach, and possibly cheese).

Cooked pasta with sauce runs about 1.3 kcal/g. With some oil and cheese in the mix, I'll use about 1.4 kcal/g. 250 g × 1.4 is about 350 kcal.
